lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: This is a Rust app providing a frozen full-screen zoom overlay for macOS.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Domain terminology (Overlay, HUD, Screenshot, Zoom vs meeting app, and related terms) lives in [CONTEXT.md](CONTEXT.md). Prefer those names in code, comments, and discussions.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Prefer AppKit views for native UI affordances; keep Core Graphics rendering focused on the frozen image/effects.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - In `objc2` code, avoid `as_super()` unless a real superclass coercion or owned upcast is needed.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - Derive HUD/layout geometry from named constants instead of unexplained magic numbers.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: - When AppKit docs suggest event APIs, first decide whether the feature is really event-driven or just geometry/state.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Issues are tracked in GitHub Issues for `matemolnar8/coomer`; external PRs are not a triage request surface. See `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: Use the default triage label vocabulary: `needs-triage`, `needs-info`, `ready-for-agent`, `ready-for-human`, and `wontfix`. See `docs/agents/triage-labels.md`.

lines.author: matemolnar8
lines.text: This repo uses a single-context domain-doc layout: root `CONTEXT.md` plus `docs/adr/`. See `docs/agents/domain.md`.
